content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"registered user with a task in my task list","i_want":"to update the details of an existing task","so_that":"my task list stays accurate when plans change","business_description":"Users can change the details of a task they have already created. The same form used to create a task is used to edit it. Each save is validated and sent to the backend, and the user sees whether the update succeeded.","business_value":"Users can correct mistakes and keep due dates and descriptions current without deleting and recreating tasks.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"an existing task is open in the edit form","when":"the user changes the title and clicks save","then":"the backend stores the new title, the task list shows the new title, and a success message is displayed"},{"given":"an existing task is open in the edit form","when":"the user clears the title field and clicks save","then":"the task is not saved, the form shows a message that the title is required, and the stored title is unchanged"},{"given":"an existing task with a creation date of 1 March","when":"the user sets the due date to 28 February and clicks save","then":"the task is not saved, the form shows a message that the due date cannot be earlier than the creation date, and the stored due date is unchanged"},{"given":"an existing task is open in the edit form and the backend returns an error for the save request","when":"the user clicks save","then":"the task list shows the previous values of the task, an error message is displayed, and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"a task that was deleted by another user session","when":"the user saves changes to it","then":"the backend responds with a task not found error, the form shows an error message, and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"a save request that sends a field value the backend does not accept","when":"the backend receives the request","then":"the backend rejects the request with an invalid input error, stores no changes, and returns the error to the frontend"},{"given":"an update request that omits the title","when":"the backend receives the request","then":"the backend rejects the request with a missing mandatory field error and stores no changes"},{"given":"a save request that fails because of an internal server or database error","when":"the backend returns the error","then":"the backend stores no partial changes and the frontend shows an error message"}],"edge_cases":["A title that contains only spaces: the PRD requires a non-empty title but does not say whether spaces-only counts as empty. This is an open question.","The due date must not be earlier than the creation date. The creation date is not editable in this story, so the check uses the stored creation date.","If the user changes a field and then leaves the form without saving, the stored task is not changed.","If the task was deleted before the user saves, the backend returns a not found error.","If the backend returns an error, the frontend must not show the edited values as saved, even briefly.","The PRD does not state how the Last Updated Date is set when a task is edited. This is an open question.","Changing the Status of a task is handled by the status change story, not by this edit form."],"dependencies":["US-create-task"],"definition_of_done":["The update endpoint for an existing task is implemented and returns the updated task on success.","The update endpoint rejects an empty title, a due date earlier than the creation date, invalid input and missing mandatory fields with clear error responses.","The update endpoint returns a not found error for a task that does not exist.","The edit form reuses the create form and is pre-filled with the stored values of the task.","The frontend shows a success message only after the backend confirms the update.","The frontend shows an error message when the backend call fails and does not show the edited values as saved.","Automated tests cover each validation rule, the not found case and the backend error case.","Open questions about whitespace-only titles and the Last Updated Date are documented in the story for the product owner."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add PUT /tasks/{id} endpoint to update an existing task","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add an endpoint that updates the editable fields of an existing task identified by ID. The message wording for success and error is not specified in the PRD and must be agreed with the product owner.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0","R-9dc414dc"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["A success message is displayed only after the backend returns a successful update.","An error message is displayed when the backend returns an error or the request fails.","After a failed update the task list shows the previous values of the task.","The wording of the success and error messages is confirmed with the product owner."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for updating an existing task","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Create the automated test suite that covers the update flow end to end: backend validation and error responses, the edit form behaviour and the feedback messages, including the case where the backend call fails.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-9b30a145","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-d57336f7","R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover a successful update, an empty title, a due date earlier than the creation date, a not found error and an internal error.","Tests confirm that no success message is shown when the backend call fails.","Tests run in the continuous integration pipeline and pass."]}]}
